variants.when: Models with the Oil Change Reminder on the infotainment screen (checked: 2023 GV70, 2025 G70 2.5T, 2026 GV80)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed. Resetting early makes the reminder show the wrong oil life.
With the vehicle parked and switched on, open the Oil Change Reminder (oil life) page on the infotainment screen. On the 2023 GV70 it is under Setup, Vehicle, Cluster.
When asked whether the engine oil has been changed, select Yes, and check that oil life reads 100%.
variants.note: The reminder does not replace the maintenance schedule. Change the oil on schedule even if no warning has appeared.

variants.when: Models showing each tire's pressure in the cluster, with no reset button (checked: 2021–2023 G70, 2021 G80, 2023 GV70)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the label on the driver's door pillar.
There is no reset button: drive normally and the pressures appear in the cluster after a short distance.
Check that all four readings match the door label. The low pressure light should go out once the system reads the corrected pressures.
variants.note: A tire pressure light that blinks for about a minute and then stays on means a system fault, which correct pressures will not clear.

notes: Genesis tire pressure systems learn new pressures by themselves while driving, so there is nothing to press. The oil reminder, where fitted, is reset from the infotainment screen, and only after the oil has actually been changed.
